rows.en:
What's this now?

"Dear Takeshi Hongo… The execution of your archenemy, Ambassador Hell, top executive of the Shocker Japan Branch, will be carried out at Ariake Warehouse No. 8…

We would very much like you all to attend as witnesses to Ambassador Hell's execution! Shocker promises not to lay a hand on any of you who attend that day!"

That Ambassador Hell!? Executed? They even politely wrote down the address.
It's a trap! As if we could trust anything Shocker says!
It may be a trap… but I don't want to just let Ambassador Hell be killed!

What are you saying, Takeshi?

He's a villain who gave us no end of trouble! If his own comrades are getting rid of him, what more could we ask for?
Oyassan… It may have been Ambassador Hell who tipped us off about Garagaranda's Poisoned Water Supply Operation.
For some reason… we think Ambassador Hell may have betrayed them.
So, Takeshi… you mean to rescue him?
Eeee!! From here on, you'll be blindfolded!
So we've got a ceasefire with you lot for the whole day, huh?
All right, let's go!

Welcome, Takeshi Hongo, Ichimonji…

Now then… we shall carry out the execution of the former Shocker executive, Ambassador Hell!

Traitor, Ambassador Hell… Do you have any last words?

Hongo…

You, my worthy rival for so long, have kindly agreed to be my witness. Allow me one last word of thanks for that. Thank you…
Ambassador Hell… I too consider it an honor to have been chosen as your witness.
Carry out the execution!!
Don't panic!! Seize Takeshi Hongo and Ambassador Hell!
Eeee! Takeshi Hongo, where is Ambassador Hell?
He may be a traitor to Shocker… but to us, he's someone we need! I won't let you kill him!! Here I come!!
What about Hongo?
No worries, no worries! If it's only combatants, he'll take care of them in no time!
That's just it! It would be fine if it were only combatants…
So… Garagaranda's going to show up too?
No, that's not it! The Leader is secretly moving a mysterious monster that even I don't know about!
A mysterious monster!?

That's right!

In fact, that's the very reason I betrayed Shocker!
Kiiii, kiiii!
Who are you!? Shocker's new monster?
Who are you!? Shocker's new monster?
Think what you like! Take the attack of the great Ganikomol! Kiiii, kiiii!
Kiiii, kiiii!
What… are you really!?
What… are you really!?
Hongo, Ichimonji… Taki rescued Ambassador Hell as planned. The operation's a success.
Mr. Hongo, Mr. Ichimonji… Taki rescued Ambassador Hell. The operation was a success.
How is it that you, a top executive, don't know who Ganikomol really is?

It's shameful…

What is world conquest without the Leader's trust! I've grown sick of Shocker's ways!

That's why I told you about Garagaranda's Poisoned Water Supply Operation.
Right, right… That unknown monster bothers me too, but Garagaranda comes first, doesn't he?

Garagaranda will go to that river again to make the Poisoned Water Supply Operation succeed…

I'll show you the way.
No, wait! You'd better stay here.
We'd like to know more about Shocker, too.
I see… Then I'll be in your care.
No, no, no… I'd rather not take too much care of you.
Well then, Oyassan… Please look after Ambassador Hell.
Be careful, Takeshi, Hayato…
Come out! Garagaranda!!
…!? Look out!
We did it!!
Ah… There's no sign of the Riders' bodies?
They were blown to smithereens.
Ah, it's the Riders!
Riders are immortal!
Now, talk! Where is Garagaranda?
Th-that's…
Shocker's new monster! Where's Garagaranda?
I am Ika-Devil, the devil's messenger!
Ika-Devil, you say!? How many times do we have to fight before you're satisfied? There's no victory for a cyborg who works for evil!
Riderrr Kiiick!!
Kick Killer!!
Ugh…
Your Rider Kick doesn't work on meee!!
Ika-Devil… Ugh… Where is… his weak point?
What are you whispering about?
For some reason… it bothers me!
It's fine… Takeshi rescued him by a hair, just before his execution. He's not a Shocker top executive anymore, is he?
According to my life-form analysis… Ambassador Hell is very likely a cyborg.
I've just got… a bad feeling.
It's fine, [HERO4]. Takeshi rescued him by a hair, just before his execution. He's not a Shocker top executive anymore, is he?

But… Colonel Zol was a wolfman, and this guy looks like a villain just from the sight of him…

Shocker's top executives are all cyborgs, right? He'll suddenly transform and go "Rawr!"…

Oh!? You're late, Hayato…

What happened to Takeshi?
Well…
Ugh…
Takeshi! Are you all right? Takeshi!!
Hey, Ichimonji… What's wrong? What happened?
He was terrifying, a terrifying guy…
Oh, Hayato… How's Takeshi doing?
Well… There's nothing to worry about for now, but to be safe, he's getting checked out at the TDF-affiliated hospital…

I see… The TDF-affiliated hospital can handle even a cyborg, so that's a relief.

Still, this is a pickle… Garagaranda, and Ika-Devil too? And an unidentified new monster on top of that. What is Shocker plotting?
I don't know… I'm going to report to the TDF. Taki, take care of Hongo.
Yeah…
Hey, Ambassador Hell… What are Garagaranda's and Ika-Devil's weak points? How do we beat them?
